categories.name: Estate Dining Table
categories.description: Hand-built dining table with mortise-and-tenon joinery, refined edge profiles, and a durable multi-stage finish. Choose length, wood species, and stain to match your dining room.

categories.name: Reach-In Closet System
categories.description: A full-height reach-in closet system with adjustable shelving, hanging rods, and pull-out storage. Built to the opening for a flush, built-in appearance.

categories.name: Live-Edge Dining Table
categories.description: A sculptural live-edge slab table balanced with engineered steel or hardwood bases. Each slab is hand-selected for grain, moisture content, and unique edge personality.

categories.name: Heirloom Kitchen Cabinets
categories.description: Architectural kitchen cabinets engineered for Maryland homes — inset or overlay doors, premium hardwoods, and a signature multi-layer finish built for daily use.

categories.name: Signature Kitchen Island
categories.description: A centerpiece island with integrated storage, optional seating overhang, and hardware selections that complement your cabinetry suite.

categories.name: Custom Dining Bench
categories.description: A companion dining bench with the same species, finish, and detailing as your table for a cohesive dining set.

categories.name: Commercial Reception Desk
categories.description: A commercial-grade reception desk with ADA-conscious transaction tops, cable management, and finish options aligned to your brand environment.

categories.name: Boutique Walk-In Closet
categories.description: Floor-to-ceiling closet millwork designed around your wardrobe. Soft-close hardware, adjustable shelving, and optional LED lighting for a boutique dressing experience.

categories.name: Architectural Fireplace Mantel
categories.description: A fireplace mantel crafted to your proportions — from clean contemporary shelves to layered traditional surrounds with matching overmantel options.
